records.name: 情报任务针板（地图上的任务钉）
records.entry: INTEL page shows a zoomed map sprinkled with teardrop mission pins
records.notes: Colour is NOT a claimability signal. Earlier project text claimed ORANGE = completed/claimable; the live client contradicts it twice on 2026-09-14: an ORANGE pin at (211,664) opened 大师悬赏：20号 read as INTEL_MASTER_BOUNTY with status BLOCKED (an actionable target, not a reward), and an ORANGE pin at (215,611) opened a Hero Journey card. What each colour encodes is UNKNOWN - do not guess it and do not decide from the colour; decide from the card the brain reads. The pin itself is the only way to learn a mission's identity: the board does not reveal type before a tap. Note also that a card's banner colour can differ from one capture to the next for the SAME mission (a Hero Journey card was read as UNKNOWN at 13:56 and as INTEL_HERO_JOURNEY at 14:00), so a template cropped from one banner colour will not match the other.

records.notes: CORRECTED 2026-09-14. This record previously said BLOCKED / BATTLE_FAILED, from a 2026-09-06 attempt whose real cause was a mis-measured 战斗 button (the template had been cropped 103 px too high), not insufficient power: the fight is won comfortably, 665.4万 vs 95.7万 recommended. Do not route through ordinary Beast Intel - the camp panel classifies as EXPLORATION, not BEAST. Cadence is still thin (1 automated win plus 1 manual win), so treat STABLE as not yet earned.
